# Fitaval – full details

> Fitaval is a fitness community platform based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It helps people discover nearby gyms, connect with a supportive community, and track their growth.

Website: https://fitaval.com/
Language: English (India)
Location: Kochi, Kerala, India

## About
Welcome to Fitaval, where we believe fitness should be accessible, social, and inspiring. Our platform helps you discover nearby gyms, connect with a supportive community, and track your growth with ease. Fitaval isn't just about workouts; it's about building a lifestyle of health, motivation, and connection.

Community figures shown on the site: 500+ happy members, 30+ weekly classes, 100+ certified trainers, 99+ customer satisfaction.

## Features
### Discover Clubs
Find gyms, studios, and workout spots near you, quickly, easily, and hassle-free.

### Events & Challenges
Take part in fitness events and challenges that keep you active.

### Redefining Fitness Business
Empowering gym owners with smart tools, analytics, and AI innovation.

### Grow Your Healthy Journey
Monitor your activity, progress, and take time to celebrate your achievements.

## Frequently asked questions
### What is Fitaval?
Fitaval is a fitness community platform based in Kochi, Kerala, India. It helps you discover nearby gyms, connect with a supportive community, and track your growth with ease.

### How do I find gyms near me?
Use Discover Clubs in Fitaval to find gyms, studios and workout spots near you, quickly, easily and hassle-free.

### What are Events & Challenges?
Fitaval lets you take part in fitness events and challenges that keep you active and motivated.

### Can gym owners use Fitaval?
Yes. Fitaval gives gym owners smart tools, analytics and AI innovation to help them run and grow their fitness business.

### How does Fitaval help me track my progress?
With Grow Your Healthy Journey you can monitor your activity and progress, and take time to celebrate your achievements.

### How do I join Fitaval?
Fill in the Join Fitaval form on this page with your name, mobile number, email and role (gym member, trainer, gym owner or other).

### How can I contact Fitaval?
Email Contact@fitaval.com or call +91 09991 77796. Fitaval is based at Taliparamba Techies Park at Rajagiri College of Social Science (Autonomous), Rajagiri Rd, Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala 683104.
